answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 147658 Country: India Title: Is deleting Quranic verses from mobile, like images, audios etc correct or sinful? Question: Is deleting Quranic verses from mobile, like images, audios etc correct or sinful? Answer ID: 147658 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 415/374/B=5/1438) It is correct to delete these Quranic verses, it is not a sin. However, it is better not to keep them in the mobile. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
